title: Uniform projection designs under the stratified $L_2$-discrepancy
summary: This paper studies a uniform projection criterion for space-filling designs under the stratified $L_2$-discrepancy. The criterion, denoted by $Φ_{SD}$, is the average squared stratified $L_2$-discrepancy over all two-dimensional projections. For U-type $(n,m,s^p)$ designs, we derive an explicit formula for $Φ_{SD}$ in terms of row-pairwise weighted hierarchical distances, and we establish sharp lower and upper bounds with equality conditions.
